primary_endpoint.name: MAE_deg
primary_endpoint.description: Mean absolute angular error between PhysioAI and the frozen physical reference in included protocol-compliant trials.

exclusions: Only exclusions frozen in the study protocol are applied automatically; manual exclusions require an explicit recorded reason.
independence_warning: Frames and repeated trials from the same participant are not treated as independent participants.
missing_data: No imputation of missing reference or invalid automatic measurements.
multiplicity: Results are reported per movement/side; no diagnostic classification claim is produced.
claim_boundary: Software method-comparison only. Passing this plan does not establish diagnostic validity or clinical effectiveness.
